name: Concentrix Scholarship Program
evidence: Female first-year MBBS students at government medical colleges, parental income up to Rs 5 lakh, up to Rs 65,000 a year for the whole course. 2026-27 applications 28 Sep to 30 Oct 2026, online on Buddy4Study. https://www.buddy4study.com/article/concentrix-scholarship

name: WINGS (Women Inspiring Growth in STEM) Scholarship, IIT Bombay
provider: IIT Bombay, funded by alumnus Bharat Desai and Neerja Sethi
evidence: Tuition (Rs 2 lakh a year) for women in IIT Bombay undergraduate programmes from 2026-27, CPI 6.0 or above, no other tuition scholarship. Second 2026 round listed as closing 31 Oct 2026. https://acr.iitbombay.org/iitb-alumnus-backed-wings-scholarship-to-transform-womens-stem-education/

name: Rupa Rahul Bajaj Scholarship for Women in Engineering
evidence: Up to Rs 8 lakh over a 4-year degree for women in core engineering branches at select top-40 colleges, 75% in Class 12. Annual; 2026-27 round listed as closing 15 Sep 2026. College notices: https://www.nitk.ac.in/document/attachments/8899/RRBSWE..pdf https://nitc.ac.in/news-and-events/empowering-the-next-generation-of-women-engineers

name: SML Mahindra Scholarship Programme (Saarthi and Unnati)
evidence: For daughters of commercial vehicle drivers: Saarthi Rs 10,000 (Class 11-12), Unnati Rs 30,000 (UG, diploma, polytechnic in STEM). 60% marks, family income up to Rs 6 lakh. 2026-27 window 21 Sep to 21 Oct 2026. https://www.dtnext.in/news/tamilnadu/dt-next-campus-applications-open-for-sml-mahindra-scholarship-programme-here-is-how-you-can-apply

name: Mahindra Saarthi Abhiyaan Scholarship
evidence: 1,000 scholarships of Rs 10,000 a year for truck drivers' daughters who have passed Class 10 and are still studying; selection through outreach at 75+ transport hubs. Annual (12th edition announced Nov 2025). https://www.mahindratruckandbus.com/english/pdf/press-release/Press_release_Mahindra_Saarthi_Abhiyaan_18%20November%202025.pdf

name: ICSSR Doctoral Fellowships
provider: Indian Council of Social Science Research (ICSSR)
evidence: Full-term, short-term and contingency-grant fellowships for full-time PhD scholars in social sciences. Annual; 2026-27 window 15 Jun to 31 Jul 2026 (extended). Official: https://www.icssr.org/node/624 apply at https://app.icssr.org

name: Jawaharlal Nehru Memorial Fund Scholarship for Doctoral Studies
evidence: Stipend for registered PhD scholars under 35 with 60% at graduate and postgraduate level, up to 2 years. Annual; 2026 round closed 31 Aug 2026. Official site https://jnmf.in ; stipend figures differ between listings, confirm on the official notice.

name: Post Graduate Indira Gandhi Scholarship for Single Girl Child
provider: University Grants Commission (UGC), on the National Scholarship Portal
evidence: Rs 36,200 a year for single girl children (and twin daughters) in the first year of a regular full-time master's, age up to 30. Applied on NSP; 2026-27 UGC window expected to close around Dec 2026. Check scholarships.gov.in and ugc.gov.in. Not the same as the UGC Savitribai Jyotirao Phule single girl child PhD fellowship we already list.

name: Scholarship for Top Class Education for Students with Disabilities
provider: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD), on the National Scholarship Portal
evidence: UG and PG at notified Institutes of Excellence, benchmark disability 40%+, parental income up to Rs 8 lakh, 300 slots a year (half for girls); tuition plus maintenance, disability and book allowances. 2026-27 NSP last date 31 Oct 2026. Check scholarships.gov.in and depwd.gov.in.

name: Indus Towers Scholarship Program for Students with Disabilities
provider: Indus Towers (CSR), implemented by Shishu Sarothi
evidence: Up to Rs 75,000 for students with 40%+ disability from vocational courses to PG; covers admission, tuition and exam fees. Annual since 2016; 2026 round listed as closed. https://scholarship.iiitk.ac.in/indus_scholarships.php https://www.buddy4study.com/scholarship/indus-towers-scholarship-program-2026

name: Samarthanam Trust Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
evidence: Admission, tuition, lab and library fees plus assistive devices for UG and PG students with disabilities, need-based. 2026-27 notice on IIT Dharwad: https://www.iitdh.ac.in/sites/default/files/2026-07/Samarthanam_Scholarship_Notice_2026-27%20%281%29.pdf provider https://samarthanam.org
